firm_data.firm_description: The Pace Women's Justice Center (PWJC) is a non-profit organization that provides free legal services for victims of domestic violence, sexual assault, and elder abuse in Westchester and Putnam Counties. PWJC also provides outreach and training on how to properly handle cases of abuse for professionals in the justice system.
notable_facts: PWJC provides free legal services to over 3,500 victims and survivors annually.
PWJC conducts or participates in over 140 training and outreach events each year.
PWJC has a walk-in clinic that provides free, bilingual legal services.
